title: More, Less and the Same: Comparing to 10
seo_title: Grade R Comparing to 10 Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_code: Grade R: Describe, compare and order numbers
standard_text: Describe, compare and order collections of objects up to 10; use the language of more, less, the same and equal.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade R maths worksheets: more, fewer and the same, the group with the most, and ordering numbers to 10. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Count each group, then compare the numbers.
  • More means the bigger number; less means the smaller number.
  • The same means equal: nothing is left over when you match them.
  • To order, start with the smallest.

Examples

Example

Which is more: 4 or 7?

7 comes later when we count

Answer: 7

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
The longer rowCount; do not look at how long the row is.
More or lessMore is the bigger number.
The orderStart with the smallest.
